summary: Completed testing of Show Image Upload feature. All 9 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified: Show Image section on ShowDetailPage with upload/replace/remove functionality, and image thumbnail display on ShowsPage show cards.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/shows/{show_id}/image endpoint correctly uploads and stores images in /app/backend/show_images/
DELETE /api/shows/{show_id}/image endpoint correctly removes image from storage and database
GET /api/uploads/show_images/{file_key} endpoint correctly serves uploaded images
Image data persists in show response (file_storage_key, file_name, mime_type, size)
ShowDetailPage.js includes 'Show Image' section with upload area, Replace/Remove buttons
ShowsPage.js ShowCard component displays image thumbnail at top of card when image exists
Invalid file types (non-images) are correctly rejected with 400 status
Old image is automatically deleted when replacing with new image
seed_data_creation: Test show created during backend testing with prefix 'TEST_' - automatically cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Show image upload feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: POST/DELETE /api/shows/{show_id}/image, GET /api/uploads/show_images/{file_key}.
